name: tiny-track-party
description: Browser-based multiplayer toy-car racing with phone tilt controllers

scripts.probe:cars: cmake -S native -B native/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && cmake --build native/build --target probe_cli --parallel >/dev/null && native/build/probe_cli matrix && native/build/probe_cli packed
scripts.probe:difficulty: cmake -S native -B native/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && cmake --build native/build --target probe_cli --parallel >/dev/null && node scripts/probe-difficulty.mjs
scripts.probe:laptime: cmake -S native -B native/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && cmake --build native/build --target probe_cli --parallel >/dev/null && native/build/probe_cli laptime
